text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Lima really is the salt of the earth, isn't she?
I doubt I'll ever meet someone as good-natured as her.
I wish other people would notice her great personality too.
choice_data_list: Tell her you feel that way.
They just need to talk to her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
リマって本当にいいやつだよね。
あそこまでのお人よし、
そうそういないと思うよ。
みんなそのことに気付いてくれたらいいのになぁ。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it'd be too awkward. Hmmm, well, that being said, if she's ever
feeling troubled, I'll let her know. Meaning, I'll never have to tell her.
'Cause people will definitely start to notice how great she is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やだよ恥ずかしい。
ん～
でも、
そうだね。
リマが本当に悩んでたら言うよ。
つまり、
そんな日は来ない。
絶対みんな
リマの良さに気付いてくれるからね。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Kids are really sharp, huh? But why aren't they frightened of her when adults always are?
It's so weird.
text_block_list.orig_text:
子どもは鋭いからねぇ。
子どもたちが怖がらないのに、
大人が怖がるなんて
おかしな話だよ。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's the part leading up to that that's the problem... Well, you're
not wrong. If anyone still thinks she's a monster after talking to her,
then I'll give 'em something to be scared of. It's not like me, but yeah.
text_block_list.orig_text:
話すまでが大変なんだけど……
まぁ、
あんたの言うとおりだね。
リマと話しても
まだリマを魔物扱いするようなやつは
あたしが
叱りつけてやる。
ガラじゃないけどね。
